notes:
Venture 0.25 — move missions between controllers by copying their files

• The Missions folder is now where the controller keeps its missions. Copy a mission's .json file into another controller's Venture/Missions folder over USB and it appears in that controller's mission list within a few seconds, with no restart. Until now copied-in files were ignored.

• Saving, renaming or deleting a mission in the app still changes its file, as before.

• Moving a file out of the folder takes that mission off the list but keeps its recorded flights on the controller. Copying the same file back brings the mission back with its flights. The controller keeps the 50 most recently used of these; older ones are deleted along with their flights.

• A copied-in mission whose name is already taken comes in as "<name>_copy". So does a file that would change a mission that has already been flown: it arrives beside the original instead of replacing it, so flights are never listed under an area they did not fly.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
